RagShortTexts: Cibidus coordinates local chiefs with separate interests.
Promised aid depends on followers’ capacity.

Variants.Content: Cibidus coordinates local chiefs and settlements; related Gothic neighbors need not recognize the same authority. Promised aid depends on followers’ capacity.

Cibidus coordinates local chiefs with separate interests. Followers retain family ties; decisions about guards and distant service affect common participation. Promised aid depends on followers’ capacity.
Promised aid depends on followers’ capacity. Coordination allocates actual supply and protection duties, not merely titles. Cibidus coordinates local chiefs with separate interests.
Cibidus coordinates local chiefs with separate interests. Households compare burdens with neighbors; unmatched protection weakens cooperation. Promised aid depends on followers’ capacity.

Promised aid depends on followers’ capacity. One promise may not bind every receiver, guard and supplier; negotiation needs actual responsibility. Cibidus coordinates local chiefs with separate interests.
